## What the original guide said

::: {.callout-note title="Archived explanation · not independently verified reporting"}
Requires the governor’s proposed budget to include funding for state employee collective bargaining agreements, including terms decided by a neutral arbitrator. It governs the proposed budget, not the final appropriation.

**Original recommendation: YES.** This records Everett’s pre-election position, not the election result. The archive retains the full reasoning.
:::

[Read the ballot guide](../guide/index.qmd#question-1).
